mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, we are looking at 78 degrees with foggy conditions out by Badger Prairie County Park. The air quality index is currently at 51, and we have a waxing gibbous moon lighting up the sky, though there are no visible space station passes tonight.

The City Clerk's Office is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for students grades K through 12. Designs must be original and include the phrase I Voted, with submissions due by July 22. Also, residents are reminded to inspect their mailboxes for winter durability and follow guidelines to avoid damage during plowing season.

Today, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, the fun continues with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Louie. Later this week, look forward to the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard on Thursday.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver had become stuck on a large rock. The 36-year-old driver was subsequently arrested for a first offense O-W-I.
Today's featured flavor is the Snickers Swirl. The shop is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Georgia Peach.
